aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who created Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. A small company that he runs himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I got to know, the more I felt they deserved better tools: something designed for a business that stands somewhere else every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That’s why I started HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It’s a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch with me, you get the answer from me, not from a customer-service waiting list.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks come to us, but I never knew which one was coming and when, unless I dug through Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I made Village Foodie: a simple way to see which food trucks are coming to the villages nearby.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Customers can order before the event for a later date or time.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by period, item and event to see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: The system accepts online orders automatically — you don’t need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand out a buzzer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A display visible to customers with the order numbers, and which order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one goes straight to its own ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest form of HatchGrab: a live kitchen display, and the only way to keep taking orders without signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collecting and redeeming are automatic.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Put together meal deals and offer add-ons at checkout, so the average order value grows.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as the WhatsApp auto-replies, but for questions arriving on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Several screens — at the front counter and in the kitchen — each with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give your staff their own login, with the right permission level.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses, so customers cannot place an order you would not see. With the iPhone, iPad and Android app you can take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Card payment in advance when customers order online — via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set an ordering deadline for items that need preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Create private events that don’t appear on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and your ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only need to review and approve it.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatic SMS to customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically add the dates, places and times for every week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: You can mark any item sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the stock: it goes down with incoming orders, then the item switches to sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Taking card payment on a supported phone, so there is no need for a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Printing order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a collection time slot, so demand is spread over the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Taking and managing orders at the counter, payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Auto-replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can make at once, and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payment on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems count on a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same opening hours every week. But you stand somewhere else week after week, at different times, with weak or no mobile network. We built HatchGrab for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically, so customers cannot place an order you would not see. You can carry on taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already use on Facebook or Instagram. We fill it in with the dates, places and times, ready to share — weekly or daily.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready by the time they arrive.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers choose the collection time themselves
landing.does.title: Tailored to food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where will you be tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Questions arriving on WhatsApp get an answer even while you are driving to the spot or standing at the grill — based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram soon.
